title: Agreement Year, Renewal and Volume Re-Rating of Insurer Program Agreements
content:
Each agreement year under the Insurer Program Agreements lasts the tier's agreement-year length in calendar months from the effective date or the last renewal date, and the agreement renews on its renewal date where the tier renews automatically, unless a termination notice is pending. At renewal, where the tier provides for volume re-rating and the year's assignments fell short of the tier's annual volume commitment, the agreement renews at the highest tier whose commitment the year's assignments met; otherwise it renews at its tier. A re-rated tier applies to repair orders opened from the renewal date on.

## The year's assignments

The current agreement year runs from the last renewal date (or, before any renewal, the effective date) to the day before the next renewal date. The year's assignments are the accepted assignments dated within that year, less the withdrawals that name one of those accepted assignments.

A renewal records the tier for the new term and the next renewal date.

## Outcomes at the renewal date

| Termination notice pending | Tier renews automatically | Re-rating provided and year's assignments short of the tier's commitment | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Any | No automatic renewal |
| No | Yes | Yes | Renews at the highest tier whose commitment the year's assignments met |
| No | Yes | No | Renews at its tier |

## Worked example (hypothetical agreement)

A hypothetical Premier Direct Repair Agreement took effect on 1 July 2024 with an agreement year of 24 calendar months, so its first year runs from 1 July 2024 to 30 June 2026 and its renewal date is 1 July 2026. Within that year 1900 assignments were accepted and 2 were declined; 120 withdrawals name accepted assignments and 2 name the declined ones. The year's assignments are 1900 less 120, or 1780. The withdrawals naming declined assignments do not reduce the count, as declined assignments were never counted.

Against the tier commitments of 2000 for the Premier Direct Repair Agreement and 750 for the Preferred Direct Repair Agreement, 1780 falls short of the Premier commitment and meets the Preferred commitment, which is the highest commitment it meets. With no termination notice pending, the agreement renews on 1 July 2026 as a Preferred Direct Repair Agreement, and the Preferred tier applies to repair orders opened from 1 July 2026 on.

## Basis questions

**Is a re-rated agreement a new agreement?** No; re-rating takes place at the renewal of the same agreement.

**Does a year's volume above the commitment move the agreement up a tier?** The clause re-rates only a year whose assignments fell short of the tier's commitment; otherwise the agreement renews at its tier.
